questions.question: [S1 Sampling] Define what is meant by a "population" in statistics.
questions.correctAnswer: The population is the entire group being studied or about which conclusions are to be drawn.
questions.explanation: The population is the entire group being studied or about which conclusions are to be drawn.

questions.question: [S1 Sampling] A school has 120 boys and 180 girls. A stratified sample of 50 students is needed. How many boys and girls should be selected?

[S2 Charts Diagrams] Calculate the angle for a pie chart sector representing 15 students out of a total of 60.
[S2 Charts Diagrams] A pictogram uses ⭐ = 6 points. How many stars are needed to represent 27 points?
questions.correctAnswer: 27 ÷ 6 = 4.5 stars (4 full stars and 1 half star)
questions.explanation: 27 ÷ 6 = 4.5 stars (4 full stars and 1 half star)
